title: I’ve Lost Artoo!
caption: •I’ve Lost Artoo (V)
game_text: Use 2 Force to deploy on table. Once per game, may use 1 Force to play an Interrupt (except Sense, Alter, or Control) from under your Starting Effect as if from hand (then place that card out of play). May place this Effect in Lost Pile to activate 1 Force.

The 745 px Premiere-D-ivelostartoo.gif is tagged D-E1 (errata face, R2 icons in text) — downloaded for art only; the 350 px decipher-archive scan is src. Lore corrected: curly double quotes (wiki straight single); 9 A's and 4 O's counted on the 745 face, matching the wiki. Copyright 1995 (Premiere) by set.
